nameOrigin.text: George Morrison, a stonemason who came to the area in 1859, platted the town that became known as Morrison.

founded.text: The town got its start when Denver businessmen led by John Evans incorporated the Denver and South Park Railway.

timeline.text: The Denver and South Park Railway was incorporated to build a narrow gauge line toward Morrison.
The railroad to Morrison was completed.
Scheduled trains to Morrison stopped running.
Red Rocks Amphitheatre was dedicated on June 15.

sites.name: Dinosaur Ridge
sites.hours: Main Visitor Center daily 9 am–4 pm Nov 1–Mar 14, 9 am–5 pm Mar 15–Oct 31; closed Thanksgiving, Christmas and New Year's Day
sites.cost: Guided bus tour $21 adults, $15 children 3–11, free 2 and under; parking free

sites.name: Red Rocks Park and Amphitheatre
sites.hours: Park open one hour before sunrise to one hour after sunset; amphitheatre usually closes to the public around 2 pm on concert days
sites.cost: Free admission and parking on non-event days
